chapter: Building the band, Ivie Anderson and touring
title: Duke writes the music; the band contributes ideas
summary: Duke had the final say, with contributions of ideas and choruses from the men.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: Now, during that period of time how did you all go about writing your material, did you all work together on it.

He had full charge of it. We didn't start individual writing. We contributed different ideas, but the bulk of it was up to Duke, you know. He had the last say, the first and last say, but, of course, even when the band was enlarged, he would encourage the guys to give ideas, but he had the final say on all that.
Even when we had a big band, all the guys contributed choruses, or different things or ideas. That's right.
